summary: Iteration 12 frontend/backend verification of office vertical (courier office onboarding, admin verification center, agreements, driver linking, settlement ownership, session isolation, business verification gate). Backend pytest re-run: test_iteration12.py 6/6 PASS (office registration+VC, agreement flow, link/invite dashboard, office settlement ownership, unverified-office driver-blocking, bearer token isolation). Frontend E2E: (A) Office registration via /register (register-role-office → name + company + terms-checkbox → submit) succeeds, redirects to /app/office, onboarding-banner renders with 38% completion + missing items chips + docs chips + 'حسابك بانتظار التوثيق من الإدارة' note. (B) Admin verification center /app/admin/verification loads with vc-offices section (3 pending offices incl. our TEST Courier Office at +966509844281), vc-approve-* and vc-reject-* buttons render, docs/businesses/drivers pending sections all render. (C) Admin offices /app/admin/offices loads full list, office-view-* buttons work, agreement form (agr-version, agr-effective, agr-issue-btn) works and returns success toast 'تم إصدار الاتفاقية وأرسلت للمكتب' — agreement AGR-2026-TEST-OFC created against TEST Courier Office. (D) MULTI-TAB SESSION ISOLATION (P0) WORKING ✓ — Tab1 (driver +966593603404) logged into /app/worker with bearer token in sessionStorage; Tab2 (business +966530534184) logged into /app/business independently; after Tab2 login, Tab1 reload still shows /app/worker as driver عماد. localStorage does NOT contain isnad_token (moved to sessionStorage as spec). (E) Business verification gate (P0) — NEW business (+966539844492) registered, dashboard loads BUT there is NO onboarding banner and NO verification-pending indicator on the business dashboard; the /app/business/requests/new wizard fully opens and lets the user progress through step 1 and step 2 without any block message — this is a UX gap (backend rejects on publish per test_iteration12, but frontend does not warn upfront). (F) Onboarding banner shows raw i18n keys on office dashboard chips: 'office.status_missing' (see rca).

ui_bugs.issue: Raw i18n keys leak in office dashboard chips ('office.status_missing' shown twice). The component does `t(`office.status_${d.status}`) || d.status` but useI18n's t() returns the key (not empty) when missing, so the || fallback never fires. Add fallback via t(k, {defaultValue: d.status}) or check the returned string equals the key.
Raw i18n keys visible on every office card: 'status.pending', 'status.verified', 'admin.crNumber' — likely dynamic t() calls without matching keys in office.json/en.json/ar.json translation files.
ui_bugs.selector: /app/admin/offices office row status badge + CR label

ui_bugs.issue: OnboardingBanner is NOT mounted on /app/business (the dashboard) — it is only on /app/business/profile. Review item (10) explicitly asks for the banner on the business DASHBOARD. Currently a newly-registered pending business sees no verification-pending indicator on its dashboard.

No verification-gate UI on /app/business/requests/new. A pending business can open the wizard and proceed through steps 1→2 with no block; only the final publish API call will fail. Review item (9) requires the wizard/publish flow to be 'blocked with verification message' — surface a full-page block or a persistent banner + disable wizard-publish-btn when user.verification_status is pending/rejected.

issues: Multiple raw translation keys leaked in Arabic UI (status.pending, status.verified, admin.crNumber, office.status_missing) — breaks the 'no raw translation keys visible' acceptance criterion.

action_items: Add missing translation keys: office.status_missing / office.status_pending / office.status_verified / office.status_rejected in office translation namespace (ar/en/ur). Alternatively fix OnboardingBanner.jsx line 45 to use `t(k, {defaultValue: d.status})` OR check `translated === k ? d.status : translated`.
Add missing translation keys on AdminOffices row: status.pending / status.verified / admin.crNumber (or hard-code the labels via existing t namespaces).

Mount OnboardingBanner on BusinessDashboard.jsx AND WorkerDashboard.jsx (currently only on their profile pages). Review item (10) mandates dashboards, and the office already has it correctly on dashboard.

Add a verification-pending block to /app/business/requests/new (RequestNew.jsx): if user.verification_status !== 'verified'/'active', render a full block with CTA to /app/business/profile and hide/disable the wizard. Same for wizard-publish-btn as a second gate.

Optional: also add the same UX gate for office drivers/settlements when office is unverified or agreement not accepted, so the driver-side PROVIDER_NOT_ELIGIBLE error is prevented at the office UI level.
critical_code_review_comments: Session isolation implementation (sessionStorage + Authorization-first backend) works end-to-end across tabs — confirmed by multi-tab test; token isolation test in backend also green. ✓
Register.jsx correctly exposes office role with company/CR fields and terms checkbox gating; register-submit-btn state transitions correctly. ✓

Admin verification center and admin offices pages both render with all required testids (vc-offices, vc-approve-*, vc-docs, office-view-*, agr-*). Agreement issuance works end-to-end with success toast. ✓
OnboardingBanner fallback bug: `t(\`office.status_${d.status}\`) || d.status` — useI18n().t() returns the KEY when missing (not empty), so `||` fallback never triggers. Common i18n bug.
Business dashboard is missing the OnboardingBanner while the office dashboard has it — inconsistent surfacing of profile-completion + verification-pending nudges.

Wizard /app/business/requests/new is not gated for pending businesses at the UI level. Backend correctly blocks per test_iteration12, but users will fill 4 steps before hitting an error. Poor UX for a P0 gate feature.

success_rate.frontend: ~80% — session isolation, office onboarding & admin agreement flow all work; two P1 UX gaps (missing business-dashboard banner + missing wizard verification-gate) and two translation-key leaks on office/admin surfaces.

For VC approve E2E, do NOT match by ancestor.textContent traversal — the vc-approve-* buttons all live in a flex list and text-contains on ancestors can false-match; instead fetch the office id via GET /api/admin/offices?status=pending then click `[data-testid=vc-approve-{id}]` directly. Focus next round on retesting after (a) OnboardingBanner mounted on business dashboard, (b) /app/business/requests/new gated, (c) missing translation keys added, then re-run driver linking + settlement UI.
rca of the issue: OnboardingBanner raw-key leak — root cause is that useI18n.t(missingKey) returns the key string itself (not undefined/empty), so `t(k) || d.status` short-circuits to the key. Fix by either (a) adding office.status_missing/pending/verified/rejected under office.* in translation files, or (b) rewriting the fallback: `const label = t(k); const clean = label === k ? d.status : label;`. AdminOffices raw keys (status.pending / status.verified / admin.crNumber) — same root cause: translation keys not defined under the namespaces referenced by the component. Grep for the exact strings across /app/frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminOffices.jsx to find the t() calls and add matching keys in /app/frontend/src/i18n/{ar,en,ur}.json.
